question: Why does a coverage-seeded generator solve 0 of 28? Per site: undiscovered, substitutable, or inexpressible?

addition_shapes.reading: A shape that already occurs in the file is a template the repo supplies; a shape that does not is text no recombination of the file can produce. This decides whether an addition generator is worth building at all.

reading: ceiling_for_the_substitution_family is the share of tasks every one of whose changed lines is a single-line substitution of tokens the file already has. No amount of ranking or budget can push a substitution-only generator past it.
